title: 3 sessions
blurb: Three sessions start at once on one project: checkout, search and docs. Each lead starts two subagents; every subagent forks its own Branch from main, writes its page with fs, then opens a Sandbox of its own to add data in a Workspace, test and commit. Each lead merges its two Branches into the session's Branch and tests it in its own Sandbox.

checkout.prompt: Build the checkout pages: a cart page and a payment page, each by its own subagent on its own Branch, then bring them together on a checkout Branch and test it. Other sessions work on the same project at the same time; stay on your own Branches.

checkout.say: Two pieces of the checkout, one subagent each, each on its own Branch.

subagent.prompt: Fork a cart Branch from main, write the cart page at app/cart/page.tsx with fs, then in a Sandbox of your own add its data in a Workspace, test, commit, and report the Branch.
Fork a pay Branch from main, write the payment page at app/pay/page.tsx with fs, then in a Sandbox of your own add its data in a Workspace, test, commit, and report the Branch.

checkout.reply: cart and pay are working in parallel; I'll merge when both report.

checkout.say: Both are ready. Merging cart and pay into a new checkout Branch; main stays as it is.

bash.description: Merge cart and pay into checkout
bash.command:
layerfs branch merge cart pay checkout -m "checkout: cart + pay"
layerfs fs list checkout /app

checkout.note: Each session merges only its own Branches, so the sessions never meet on main.

checkout.say: Testing checkout in a Sandbox of mine.

bash.description: Test checkout in a Workspace
bash.command:
layerfs sandbox create | tee sandbox-checkout.json
layerfs workspace mount "$(jq -r .sandbox sandbox-checkout.json)" checkout | tee ws-checkout.json
layerfs workspace exec "$(jq -r .ws ws-checkout.json)" "sh test.sh && ls app/cart app/pay" --stream

checkout.say: Tests pass. Unmounting and closing my Sandbox.

bash.description: Unmount and close my Sandbox
bash.command:
layerfs workspace unmount {{ws}}
layerfs sandbox close {{sandbox}}

checkout.reply: Branch checkout holds cart and pay, merged with no conflicts and tested; every Sandbox of this session is closed.

cart.say: Forking cart from main and writing the cart page with fs.

bash.description: Fork cart and write its page

cart.say: A Sandbox of my own, and a Workspace of cart in it; I keep both open while I work.

bash.description: Open a Sandbox and mount cart
bash.command:
layerfs sandbox create | tee sandbox-cart.json
layerfs workspace mount "$(jq -r .sandbox sandbox-cart.json)" cart | tee ws-cart.json
layerfs workspace exec "$(jq -r .ws ws-cart.json)" "sh test.sh" --stream

cart.note: Each subagent of each session has its own Sandbox: Live shows them all open at once.

cart.say: Adding the page's data in the Workspace, then testing and committing it.

bash.description: Add app/cart/data.ts in the Workspace and commit
bash.command:
layerfs workspace exec {{ws}} "printf 'export const items = 0;\\n' > app/cart/data.ts && sh test.sh" --stream
layerfs workspace commit {{ws}} -m "cart: add app/cart/data.ts"

cart.say: Done here: unmounting and closing my Sandbox.

bash.description: Unmount and close my Sandbox
bash.command:
layerfs workspace unmount {{ws}}
layerfs sandbox close {{sandbox}}

cart.reply: Ready: Branch cart, with app/cart/page.tsx and data.ts committed and the tests passing.
